preparation: One coherent returning-mode input, other active ports vacuum; same nominal cavity map at two independently calibrated intensities
measurement: Complex field means A1,A2 from phase-referenced readout; use their magnitudes. Mean photon counts are not this observable.
statistic: S=|A2|/(2*|A1|), with a positive certified lower bound for |A1|
calibration_status: Required independent design bounds; no measured calibration or data supplied
rival: For the active-port Kerr phase chi*t=pi/2: S=r*sqrt(lambda2/lambda1)/2 * exp(-2*(lambda2-lambda1))
gain_policy: A common unknown complex multiplicative readout gain cancels; relative magnitude drift r is independently bounded. Gains/intensities must not be fitted to the validation means.
decision: Compare a simultaneously certified confidence interval for S with each full nuisance prediction enclosure enlarged by epsilon=1/100; disjointness excludes that named model. Overlap is inconclusive, not confirmation of uniqueness.
source_sensitive_reason: Both laws preserve number and agree on one-photon tests, but their coherent field means have different intensity dependence
scope: One round and one fixed phase rival. Arbitrarily small nonlinear phases and other source laws require their own tests.
